Today I brought my son to see Dr. Torfan for a dental check-up and fluoride treatment. 🦷✨
I was very impressed. The doctor was very attentive, patient, and spoke kindly, which made my son feel relaxed and not afraid at all. 😊

The clinic was very clean, the equipment looked new and spotless. The atmosphere was warm, which made me feel very comfortable. ❤️
Thank you very much, Dr. Torfan.
The price is quite high compared to other places, and the doctor has a heavy hand.

text: I think the queuing system needs improvement. I had an appointment at 1 PM, but walk-in customers were served first, and then I had to wait another hour and still wasn't served. What's the point of having an appointment system if people who arrive on time can't get served? A 10-15 minute delay is understandable, but an hour is too much.

The wait time wasn't long, and the service was excellent. The doctor provided great advice and consultation.
The atmosphere inside was spacious and clean, there was parking available, and the clinic was easy to find. 😊 …
The clinic is conveniently located and has parking. The clinic is clean, the staff provides excellent service, and the doctor is very kind and lovely.

This is my second time here for tartar removal, and I'm impressed both times. The staff are incredibly polite, and the dentist is very gentle, kind, and constantly asks if I'm in pain. Highly recommend! 👍🏻❤️ …

I used their services two years ago, using social security insurance for a teeth cleaning. There were no extra charges. The dentist was excellent, and the staff were lovely. I even recommended them to friends.

However, this year, using social security insurance, they charged an extra 100฿ (for tooth coating), which should have been mentioned during the appointment. I only found out while lying down next to the dentist, and the dentist informed me before the procedure.

I was already frowning at the extra 100฿. The teeth cleaning was messy; water flowed up to the back of my neck and splashed everywhere—more than at a salon. It was finished in 9 minutes, and then they gave me a tooth coating to hold for another 5 minutes.

My first impression from this visit is completely gone.
